description: How much was liquidated: the last 24 hours and the last hour, longs against shorts, for the whole crypto market or for one coin. Use it for questions like "how much was liquidated today", "were longs or shorts liquidated", "which exchange had the most liquidations". Returns the totals, the split by coin (whole market) or by exchange (one coin), the largest liquidations of the last hour, and the URL of the page.

coin.description: One of BTC, ETH, SOL, XRP, DOGE, HYPE, BNB; omit it for the whole crypto market
